solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       MIN(booked_at) AS first_booked,
       MAX(booked_at) AS last_booked
FROM shipments
WHERE booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND booked_at <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;

ambiguities.readingChosen: Only customer_ids with a shipment booked in the window appear (6 rows here).
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Every customer in the customers table, with NULL first and last bookings for customers with no January bookings (8 rows here).

notes: Shipment 49 (customer 1, booked exactly 2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) sets customer 1's first_booked, so the inclusive lower bound matters.
